capital.evidence_quote: Kampala is the capital and largest commercial metropolis of the Republic of Uganda

currency.evidence_quote: The Uganda Shilling (UGX) is the legal national currency of Uganda

timezone.evidence_quote: Uganda observes East Africa Time UTC+3 year-round without daylight saving adjustments

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard single-phase consumer supply voltage in Uganda is 240V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: The national electrical power grid operates continuously at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Sockets in Uganda adhere strictly to the British three-rectangular-pin Type G design

police.evidence_quote: Dial 999 or 112 for emergency police assistance throughout Uganda

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 911 or Red Cross ambulance services for urgent medical dispatch

sources.title: UPF Directorate of Fire Prevention and Rescue

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 112 for emergency fire and rescue services

general.evidence_quote: 112 operates as the unified toll-free cellular emergency dispatch number

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Specialised Tourist Police Department coordinates 24/7 security escorts in national parks

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Bwindi ve Queen Elizabeth milli parkları silahlı korucular eşliğinde güvenlidir; DRC sınır ormanlarına dikkat edilmelidir.
advisory_headline.en: Bwindi Impenetrable Forest and safari parks are secured by armed wildlife rangers; exercise caution near DRC borders.
advisory_headline.de: Bwindi-Nationalpark und Safarigebiete werden durch Ranger gesichert; Grenznähe zur DR Kongo meiden.
advisory_headline.ru: Национальные парки Бвинди и Королевы Елизаветы охраняются рейнджерами UWA; будьте осторожны у границы с ДРК.
advisory_headline.es: Los parques Bwindi y Queen Elizabeth están custodiados por guardaparques armados; precaución cerca de la RDC.

regional_warnings.area: Western Border with DRC and Karamoja region
regional_warnings.reason: Presence of armed rebel groups in neighboring DRC forests and cattle rustling incidents.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Uganda reach approximately 28.2 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Uganda measure 39.4 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: All visitors must apply for an electronic visa online at visas.immigration.go.ug before departure. MTN Uganda and Airtel offer prepaid 4G tourist eSIMs; yellow fever vaccination card is mandatory at immigration.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: All visa applications must be completed online prior to passenger arrival

local_apps.name: SafeBoda
local_apps.description: Uganda's renowned motorcycle taxi hailing app; drivers are trained and provide clean passenger helmets.

local_apps.name: Uber / Bolt
local_apps.description: Widely available car taxi-hailing apps in Kampala and Entebbe.

local_apps.name: Jumia Food
local_apps.description: Leading restaurant meal and grocery delivery platform in Kampala.

local_apps.name: MTN MoMo
local_apps.description: Ubiquitous mobile money payment service accepted across Uganda.

tr.conditions: Türk vatandaşları seyahatten önce online e-Visa (visas.immigration.go.ug, 50$) veya Doğu Afrika Vizesi (100$) almak zorundadır. Sarıhumma aşı kartı zorunludur.

us.conditions: US citizens must obtain an approved eVisa online ($50 USD) or East Africa Tourist Visa prior to arrival.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens must secure an approved electronic visa prior to departure.

gb.conditions: British passport holders must apply for and receive an eVisa approval letter online before traveling to Uganda.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ должны оформить электронную визу (eVisa) на сайте visas.immigration.go.ug до вылета в Уганду.

dos.title: Carry an official Yellow Fever vaccination certificate
dos.description: Proof of yellow fever vaccination is legally mandatory for all arriving travelers aged 1 year and older.

dos.title: Use SafeBoda for motorcycle rides in Kampala
dos.description: Boda-bodas are the fastest way through Kampala traffic, but SafeBoda drivers are trained and supply passenger helmets.

dos.title: Try the famous 'Rolex' street food
dos.description: A 'Rolex' (rolled eggs) is a delicious omelet with tomatoes rolled inside a freshly griddled hot chapati.

donts.title: Don't track gorillas if feeling sick with a cold
donts.description: Gorillas share 98% of human DNA and have no immunity to human respiratory viruses; rangers will turn away sick tourists.

donts.title: Don't photograph military or government convoys
donts.description: Photography of military personnel, state installations, or Entebbe airport checkpoint zones is strictly forbidden.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping 10% in sit-down restaurants is customary; tipping gorilla trackers and UWA rangers ($10-15 per day) is customary.
